
```{r setup, include = TRUE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(glue)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(car)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggeffects)
library(ggsignif)
library(patchwork)
library(effectsize)
library(TOSTER)
library(broom.mixed)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
conf <- config::get()
```

```{r load-data}
brainager_predictions <- read.csv(here("data/processed/converter_dataset_matched_corrected.csv"))
unmatched_dataset <- read.csv(here("data/processed/converter_dataset_trimmed_con.csv"))

full_dataset <- brainager_predictions %>%
    filter(!is.na(brain_age), !is.na(assessment_exact)) %>%
    mutate(
        cohort = as.factor(cohort),
        scanner = as.factor(scanner),
        site = as.factor(site),
        tiv = gmv + wmv + csf,
        duration_episodes_depr = ifelse(is.na(duration_episodes_depr), 0, duration_episodes_depr),
        group = factor(group, levels = c("HC", "MDD", "CON"), labels = c("HC", "MDD", "CON")),
        remission = factor(remission, levels = c("Non-remitted", "Remitted", "Healthy"), labels = c("Non-remitted", "Remitted", "Healthy")),
        recurrence = factor(recurrence, levels = c("Non-recurring", "Recurring", "Healthy"), labels = c("Non-recurring", "Recurring", "Healthy")),
    ) %>%
    select(
        subject_id, group, cohort, assessment, assessment_exact,
        BAG, BAG_corrected, brain_age,
        sex, chronological_age, tiv, scanner,
        cesd, bdi, HAMD17, onset_age, remission, recurrence, duration_episodes_depr, number_episodes_depr, medindex, BMI
    )

mnc_macs_longitudinal <- full_dataset %>% filter(cohort %in% c("mnc", "macs"))
mnc_macs_baseline <- mnc_macs_longitudinal %>% filter(assessment_exact == 0)
mnc_macs_followup <- mnc_macs_longitudinal %>% filter(assessment_exact > 0)

bidirect_longitudinal <- full_dataset %>% filter(cohort == "bidirect")
bidirect_baseline <- bidirect_longitudinal %>% filter(assessment_exact == 0)
bidirect_followup <- bidirect_longitudinal %>% filter(assessment_exact > 0)

mm_clinical_followup <- mnc_macs_followup %>% filter(group %in% c("CON", "MDD"))
bd_clinical_followup <- bidirect_followup %>% filter(group %in% c("CON", "MDD"))
mm_clinical_longitudinal <- mnc_macs_longitudinal %>% filter((group == "CON" & assessment_exact > 0) | group == "MDD")
bd_clinical_longitudinal <- bidirect_longitudinal %>% filter((group == "CON" & assessment_exact > 0) | group == "MDD")

mnc_macs_lmer_model <- lmer(
    BAG ~ group * assessment_exact + poly(chronological_age, 2) + sex + scale(tiv) + (1 | subject_id) + (1 | scanner),
    data = mnc_macs_longitudinal,
)
bidirect_lmer_model <- lmer(
    BAG ~ group * assessment_exact + poly(chronological_age, 2) + sex + scale(tiv) + (1 | subject_id),
    data = bidirect_longitudinal,
)
```

```{r}
    summarise(
        n = n(),
        mean_age = mean(chronological_age, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_age = sd(chronological_age, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_bag = mean(BAG_corrected, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_bag = sd(BAG_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
bidirect_baseline %>% group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
        n = n(),
        mean_age = mean(chronological_age, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_age = sd(chronological_age, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_bag = mean(BAG_corrected, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_bag = sd(BAG_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
```

# baseline differences
## clincal characteristics
```{r}
message("HAMD")
mm_hamd_model <- lm(
    HAMD17 ~ group + sex + poly(chronological_age, 2),
    data = mnc_macs_baseline
)
mm_hamd_anova <- Anova(mm_hamd_model, type = "III")
print(mm_hamd_anova)
eta_squared(mm_hamd_anova, partial = TRUE)
mm_hamd_emm <- emmeans(mm_hamd_model, pairwise ~ group, adjust = "tukey")
print(mm_hamd_emm)
confint(mm_hamd_emm$contrasts)
eff_size(emmeans(mm_hamd_model, ~ group), sigma = sigma(mm_hamd_model), edf = df.residual(mm_hamd_model))

clincically_relevant_hamd_delta <- 7 # suggested by Moncrieff & Kirsch 2015
hamd_con_hc_tost <- tsum_TOST(
    m1           = 1.01,                  # Absolute estimate of the HC-CON difference
    sd1          = 0.875 * sqrt(511 + 1), # se + sqrt(df)
    n1           = 511 + 1,               # df +1
    low_eqbound  = -clincically_relevant_hamd_delta,           
    high_eqbound = clincically_relevant_hamd_delta,            
    hypothesis   = "EQU"
)
print(hamd_con_hc_tost)
```

```{r}
message("BDI")
mm_bdi_model <- lm(
    bdi ~ group + sex + poly(chronological_age, 2),
    data = mnc_macs_baseline
)
mm_bdi_anova <- Anova(mm_bdi_model, type = "III")
print(mm_bdi_anova)
eta_squared(mm_bdi_anova, partial = TRUE)
mm_bdi_emm <- emmeans(mm_bdi_model, pairwise ~ group, adjust = "tukey") # HC - CON in paper
print(mm_bdi_emm)
confint(mm_bdi_emm$contrasts)
eff_size(emmeans(mm_bdi_model, ~ group), sigma = sigma(mm_bdi_model), edf = df.residual(mm_bdi_model))

clincically_relevant_bdi_delta <- 22.12 * 0.175   # emmean MDD * percentage for clinically relevant difference (Button, 2015)

bdi_con_hc_tost <- tsum_TOST(
    m1           = 3.17,                 # Absolute estimate of the HC-CON difference
    sd1          = 1.36 * sqrt(496 + 1), # se + sqrt(df)
    n1           = 496 + 1,              # df +1
    low_eqbound  = -clincically_relevant_bdi_delta,
    high_eqbound = clincically_relevant_bdi_delta,
    hypothesis   = "EQU"
)
print(bdi_con_hc_tost)
```

```{r}
message("CES-D")

    cesd ~ group + sex + poly(chronological_age, 2),
    data = bidirect_baseline
)
bd_cesd_anova <- Anova(bd_cesd_model, type = "III")
print(bd_cesd_anova)

cesd_con_hc_tost <- tsum_TOST(

    sd1          = 1.94 * sqrt(334 + 1),  # se + sqrt(df)

print(cesd_con_hc_tost)
```

# Vulnerability
## mnc macs
```{r}
message("MNC+MACS Baseline Differences")
mm_bag_model <- lm(
    BAG ~ group + poly(chronological_age, 2) + sex + tiv + scanner, 
    data = mnc_macs_baseline
)
mm_bag_anova <- Anova(mm_bag_model, type = "III")
print(mm_bag_anova)
eta_squared(mm_bag_anova, partial = TRUE)
cat("\n\n")

# post-hoc contrasts
mm_bag_contrasts <- emmeans(mm_bag_model, pairwise ~ group, adjust = "tukey")
print(mm_bag_contrasts$contrasts)
# 95% Tukey-adjusted confidence intervals for each group contrast
mm_bag_contrasts_ci <- confint(mm_bag_contrasts$contrasts, level = 0.95)
print(mm_bag_contrasts_ci)

eff_size(emmeans(mm_bag_model, ~ group), sigma = sigma(mm_bag_model), edf = df.residual(mm_bag_model))

cat("TOST Equivalence Testing:\n")
mm_vul_contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(mm_bag_contrasts$contrasts)
hc_con <- mm_vul_contrasts_df[mm_vul_contrasts_df$contrast == "HC - CON", ]
hc_mdd <- mm_vul_contrasts_df[mm_vul_contrasts_df$contrast == "HC - MDD", ]

mm_vul_tost_delta <- abs(hc_mdd$estimate)

mm_vul_adjusted_tost <- tsum_TOST(
    m1           = hc_con$estimate,
    sd1          = hc_con$SE * sqrt(hc_con$df + 1),
    n1           = hc_con$df + 1,
    low_eqbound  = -mm_vul_tost_delta,
    high_eqbound = mm_vul_tost_delta,
    hypothesis   = "EQU"
)
print(mm_vul_adjusted_tost)
```

```{r}
message("MNC+MACS Baseline Differences - JAMA unadjusted")
mm_bag_model_unadjusted <- lm(
    BAG ~ group + poly(chronological_age, 2),
    data = mnc_macs_baseline
)
mm_bag_anova_unadjusted <- Anova(mm_bag_model_unadjusted, type = "III")

print(mm_bag_contrasts_unadjusted_ci)

eff_size(emmeans(mm_bag_model_unadjusted, ~ group), sigma = sigma(mm_bag_model_unadjusted), edf = df.residual(mm_bag_model_unadjusted))
```

## bidirect
```{r}
message("BiDirect Baseline Differences")
bd_bag_model <- lm(
    BAG ~ group + poly(chronological_age, 2) + sex + tiv, 
    data = bidirect_baseline
)

bd_bag_anova <- Anova(bd_bag_model, type = "III")
print(bd_bag_anova)
eta_squared(bd_bag_anova, partial = TRUE)
cat("\n\n")

# post-hoc contrasts
bd_bag_contrasts <- emmeans(bd_bag_model, pairwise ~ group, adjust = "tukey")
print(bd_bag_contrasts$contrasts)
bd_bag_contrasts_ci <- confint(bd_bag_contrasts$contrasts, level = 0.95)
print(bd_bag_contrasts_ci)

eff_size(emmeans(bd_bag_model, ~ group), sigma = sigma(bd_bag_model), edf = df.residual(bd_bag_model))

cat("TOST Equivalence Testing:\n")
bd_vul_contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(bd_bag_contrasts$contrasts)
bd_hc_con <- bd_vul_contrasts_df[bd_vul_contrasts_df$contrast == "HC - CON", ]
bd_hc_mdd <- bd_vul_contrasts_df[bd_vul_contrasts_df$contrast == "HC - MDD", ]

bd_vul_tost_delta <- abs(bd_hc_mdd$estimate)
bd_vul_adjusted_tost <- tsum_TOST(
    m1          = bd_hc_con$estimate,
    sd1         = bd_hc_con$SE * sqrt(bd_hc_con$df + 1),
    n1          = bd_hc_con$df + 1,
    low_eqbound = -bd_vul_tost_delta,
    high_eqbound = bd_vul_tost_delta,
    hypothesis  = "EQU"
)
print(bd_vul_adjusted_tost)
```

# State
## Trajectory differences
### mnc macs
```{r}
mm_lmer_anova <- Anova(mnc_macs_lmer_model, type = "3", test.statistic = "F") # Type III ANOVA to test the interaction effect
print(mm_lmer_anova)
cat("\n--- fixed effects (effect strengths) ---\n")
eta_squared(mm_lmer_anova, partial = TRUE)
mm_lmer_slopes <- emtrends(mnc_macs_lmer_model, pairwise ~ group, var = "assessment_exact")
cat("\n--- Slopes (emtrends) ---\n")
summary(mm_lmer_slopes$emtrends)
cat("\n--- Slopes (contrasts) ---\n")
summary(mm_lmer_slopes$contrasts)
confint(mm_lmer_slopes$contrasts)

mm_slope_effect_sizes <- eff_size(
    mm_lmer_slopes$emtrends,
    sigma = sigma(mnc_macs_lmer_model),
    edf = df.residual(mnc_macs_lmer_model)
)
cat("\n--- Standardized Effect Sizes (Cohen's d) for Slope Differences ---\n")
summary(mm_slope_effect_sizes)
```

```{r}
mm_slopes_df <- as.data.frame(mm_lmer_slopes$contrasts)

# Calculate the raw equivalence bound corresponding to d = 0.20
mm_eq_bound_raw <- 0.20 * sigma(mnc_macs_lmer_model)
cat(sprintf("Raw equivalence boundary for d = 0.20: +/- %.4f BAG years/year\n\n", mm_eq_bound_raw))

mm_hc_con_slope  <- mm_slopes_df[mm_slopes_df$contrast == "HC - CON", ]
mm_con_mdd_slope <- mm_slopes_df[mm_slopes_df$contrast == "MDD - CON", ]

# === TOST 1: CON vs. HC ===
cat("=== TOSTER: Is the CON slope equivalent to the HC slope? ===\n")
mm_tost_con_hc <- tsum_TOST(
    m1           = mm_hc_con_slope$estimate,
    sd1          = mm_hc_con_slope$SE * sqrt(round(mm_hc_con_slope$df) + 1),
    n1           = round(mm_hc_con_slope$df) + 1,
    low_eqbound  = -mm_eq_bound_raw,
    high_eqbound = mm_eq_bound_raw,
    eqbound_type = "raw",
    hypothesis   = "EQU"
)
print(mm_tost_con_hc)

# === TOST 2: CON vs. MDD ===
cat("\n=== TOSTER: Is the CON slope equivalent to the MDD slope? ===\n")
mm_tost_con_mdd <- tsum_TOST(
    m1           = mm_con_mdd_slope$estimate,
    sd1          = mm_con_mdd_slope$SE * sqrt(round(mm_con_mdd_slope$df) + 1),
    n1           = round(mm_con_mdd_slope$df) + 1,
    low_eqbound  = -mm_eq_bound_raw,
    high_eqbound = mm_eq_bound_raw,
    eqbound_type = "raw",
    hypothesis   = "EQU"
)
print(mm_tost_con_mdd)
```

```{r}
    edf = df.residual(bidirect_lmer_model)
)

summary(bidirect_slope_effect_sizes)
```

```{r}

bidirect_hc_con_slope  <- bidirect_slopes_df[bidirect_slopes_df$contrast == "HC - CON", ]
bidirect_con_mdd_slope <- bidirect_slopes_df[bidirect_slopes_df$contrast == "MDD - CON", ]

# === TOST 1: CON vs. HC ===

bidirect_tost_con_hc <- tsum_TOST(

    sd1          = bidirect_hc_con_slope$SE * sqrt(round(bidirect_hc_con_slope$df) + 1),
    n1           = round(bidirect_hc_con_slope$df) + 1,
    low_eqbound  = -bidirect_eq_bound_raw,
    high_eqbound = bidirect_eq_bound_raw,
    eqbound_type = "raw",

)
print(bidirect_tost_con_hc)

# === TOST 2: CON vs. MDD ===
cat("\n=== TOSTER: Is the CON slope equivalent to the MDD slope? ===\n")
bidirect_tost_con_mdd <- tsum_TOST(
    m1           = bidirect_con_mdd_slope$estimate,
    sd1          = bidirect_con_mdd_slope$SE * sqrt(round(bidirect_con_mdd_slope$df) + 1),
    n1           = round(bidirect_con_mdd_slope$df) + 1,
    low_eqbound  = -bidirect_eq_bound_raw,
    high_eqbound = bidirect_eq_bound_raw,
    eqbound_type = "raw",
    hypothesis   = "EQU"
)
print(bidirect_tost_con_mdd)
```

## follow-up differences via Cross-Sectional analysis
### macs + mnc
```{r}
print("Cross-sectional Association at Follow-up")
print("HAMD17")
mm_hamd_state_model <- lm(BAG ~ HAMD17 + poly(chronological_age, 2) + sex + tiv + scanner, data = mm_clinical_followup)
mm_hamd_state_anova <- Anova(mm_hamd_state_model, type = "III")
print(mm_hamd_state_anova)
eta_squared(mm_hamd_state_anova, partial = TRUE)

mm_hamd_state_pcorr <- t_to_r(
    t = summary(mm_hamd_state_model)$coefficients["HAMD17", "t value"],
    df_error = mm_hamd_state_model$df.residual
)
print("partial correlation:")
print(mm_hamd_state_pcorr)

print("group effect:")
print(Anova(lm(BAG ~ group + HAMD17 + poly(chronological_age, 2) + sex + tiv + scanner, data = mm_clinical_followup), type = "III"))

print("BDI")
mm_bdi_state_model <- lm(BAG ~ bdi + poly(chronological_age, 2) + sex + tiv + scanner, data = mm_clinical_followup)
mm_bdi_state_anova <- Anova(mm_bdi_state_model, type = "III")
print(mm_bdi_state_anova)
eta_squared(mm_bdi_state_anova, partial = TRUE)

mm_bdi_state_pcorr <- t_to_r(
    t = summary(mm_bdi_state_model)$coefficients["bdi", "t value"],
    df_error = mm_bdi_state_model$df.residual
)
print("partial correlation:")
print(mm_bdi_state_pcorr, digits=4)

print("group effect:")
print(Anova(lm(BAG ~ group + bdi + poly(chronological_age, 2) + sex + tiv + scanner, data = mm_clinical_followup), type = "III"))
```

## longitudinal differences via Change-Score Analysis
### macs + mnc
```{r}
mm_clinical_delta_data <- mnc_macs_longitudinal %>%
    group_by(subject_id) %>%
    filter(n() > 1, group %in% c("CON", "MDD")) %>%
    summarize(
        delta_bag  = BAG[assessment_exact != 0] - BAG[assessment_exact == 0],
        delta_hamd = HAMD17[assessment_exact != 0] - HAMD17[assessment_exact == 0],
        delta_bdi  = bdi[assessment_exact != 0] - bdi[assessment_exact == 0],
        chronological_age_baseline = chronological_age[assessment_exact == 0],
        sex = first(sex),
        tiv = first(tiv),
        scanner = first(scanner),
        group = first(group)
    )

print("Longitudinal Change Scores - delta HAMD")

mm_hamd_delta_model <- lm(
    delta_bag ~ delta_hamd + poly(chronological_age_baseline, 2) + sex + tiv + scanner, 
    data = mm_clinical_delta_data
)
mm_hamd_delta_anova <- Anova(mm_hamd_delta_model, type = "III")
print(mm_hamd_delta_anova)
eta_squared(mm_hamd_delta_anova, partial = TRUE)
mm_hamd_delta_pcorr <- t_to_r(
    t = summary(mm_hamd_delta_model)$coefficients["delta_hamd", "t value"],
    df_error = mm_hamd_delta_model$df.residual
)

print("partial correlation:")
print(mm_hamd_delta_pcorr, digits=4)

print("Longitudinal Change Scores - delta BDI")
mm_bdi_delta_model <- lm(
    delta_bag ~ delta_bdi + poly(chronological_age_baseline, 2) + sex + tiv + scanner, 
    data = mm_clinical_delta_data
)
mm_bdi_delta_anova <- Anova(mm_bdi_delta_model, type = "III")
print(mm_bdi_delta_anova)
eta_squared(mm_bdi_delta_anova, partial = TRUE)
mm_bdi_delta_pcorr <- t_to_r(
    t = summary(mm_bdi_delta_model)$coefficients["delta_bdi", "t value"],
    df_error = mm_bdi_delta_model$df.residual
)
print("partial correlation:")
print(mm_bdi_delta_pcorr, digits=4)
```

```{r}
# Panel B2: BDI Change
p_b2 <- ggplot(mm_corr_plot_long, aes(x = d_bdi_res, y = d_bag_res)) +
  ylim(-10, 10) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "#2C3E50") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#3498DB", fill = "#3498DB", alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Longitudinal Course", x = "\u0394BDI (Adjusted)", y = "\u0394BAG (Adjusted)") + thm

# Panel C1: CESD State
p_c1 <- ggplot(bd_corr_plot_cross, aes(x = cesd_res, y = bag_res)) +
  ylim(-10, 10) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "#2C3E50") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#009E73", fill = "#009E73", alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Cross-Sectional State", x = "CES-D (Adjusted)", y = "BAG (Adjusted)") + thm

# Panel C2: CESD Change
p_c2 <- ggplot(bd_corr_plot_long, aes(x = d_cesd_res, y = d_bag_res)) +
  ylim(-10, 10) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "#2C3E50") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#009E73", fill = "#009E73", alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Longitudinal Course", x = "\u0394CES-D (Adjusted)", y = "\u0394BAG (Adjusted)") + thm

state_marker_plot <- (p_a1 + p_b1) / (p_a2 + p_b2) + (p_c1 + p_c2) +

print(state_marker_plot)
ggsave("Analysis_2_Scatter.png", state_marker_plot, width = 9, height = 7.5)
```

# scar effect
## MACS + MNC
### duration
```{r}
# Linear Mixed Model for Cumulative Duration
scar_model_duration <- lmer(
    BAG ~ duration_episodes_depr + poly(chronological_age, 2) + sex + scale(tiv) + (1 | subject_id) + (1 | scanner), 
    data = mnc_macs_longitudinal %>% filter(group %in% c("CON", "MDD"))
)
summary(scar_model_duration)
confint(scar_model_duration)
print(eta_squared(scar_model_duration, partial = TRUE))

stats_table <- coef(summary(scar_model_duration))
t_duration <- stats_table["duration_episodes_depr", "t value"]
df_duration <- stats_table["duration_episodes_depr", "df"]

scar_model_duration_partial_r <- t_to_r(t = t_duration, df_error = df_duration)
print(scar_model_duration_partial_r, digits = 4)
```

```{r}
scar_model_duration_unadjusted <- lmer(
    BAG ~ duration_episodes_depr + poly(chronological_age, 2) + (1 | subject_id) + (1 | scanner),
    data = mnc_macs_longitudinal %>% filter(group %in% c("CON", "MDD"))
)
summary(scar_model_duration_unadjusted)
confint(scar_model_duration_unadjusted)
```

```{r}
# Run TOST using the summary statistics engine
tost_duration <- corsum_test(
    r           = scar_model_duration_partial_r$r,
    n           = df_duration + 1, # Effective sample size
    alternative = "equivalence",
    null        = 0.10,
    method      = "pearson"
)
print("=== TOST: Main Effect of Cumulative Duration ===")
print(tost_duration)
```

```{r}
# Testing interaction term
scar_model_duration_interaction <- lmer(
    BAG ~ duration_episodes_depr * assessment_exact + poly(chronological_age, 2) + sex + scale(tiv) + (1 | subject_id) + (1 | scanner), 
    data = mnc_macs_longitudinal %>% filter(group %in% c("CON", "MDD"))
)
summary(scar_model_duration_interaction)

stats_table <- coef(summary(scar_model_duration_interaction))
t_duration_interaction  <- stats_table["duration_episodes_depr:assessment_exact", "t value"]
df_duration_interaction <- stats_table["duration_episodes_depr:assessment_exact", "df"]

scar_model_duration_interaction_partial_r <- t_to_r(t = t_duration_interaction, df_error = df_duration_interaction)
print(scar_model_duration_interaction_partial_r, digits = 4)
```

```{r}
# Run TOST
tost_interaction <- corsum_test(
    r           = scar_model_duration_interaction_partial_r$r,
    n           = df_duration_interaction + 1,
    alternative = "equivalence",
    null        = 0.10,
    method      = "pearson"
)
print("=== TOST: Interaction (Duration x Time) ===")
print(tost_interaction)
```

### recurrence
```{r}
# Comparing Single vs. Recurrent episodes
scar_model_recurrent <- lmer(
    BAG ~ recurrence + poly(chronological_age, 2) + sex + scale(tiv) + (1 | subject_id) + (1 | scanner),
    data = mnc_macs_longitudinal %>% filter(!is.na(recurrence), group %in% c("CON", "MDD"))
)
# summary(scar_model_recurrent)
scar_anova_recurrent <- anova(scar_model_recurrent, type = "III")
scar_anova_recurrent
eta_squared(scar_anova_recurrent)

# Post-hoc comparison
scar_emm <- emmeans(scar_model_recurrent, pairwise ~ recurrence, lmer.df = "satterthwaite")
confint(scar_emm)
```

```{r}
scar_model_recurrent_unadjusted <- lmer(
    BAG ~ recurrence + poly(chronological_age, 2) + (1 | subject_id) + (1 | scanner),
    data = mnc_macs_longitudinal %>% filter(!is.na(recurrence), group %in% c("CON", "MDD"))
)
# summary(scar_model_recurrent_unadjusted)
scar_anova_recurrent <- anova(scar_model_recurrent_unadjusted, type = "III")
scar_anova_recurrent
```

```{r}
scar_recurring_contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(scar_emm$contrasts)

tost_recurrence_group_nrec <- tsum_TOST(
    m1           = scar_recurring_contrasts_df$estimate[1],
    sd1          = scar_recurring_contrasts_df$SE[1] * sqrt(scar_recurring_contrasts_df$df[1] + 1),
    n1           = scar_recurring_contrasts_df$df[1] + 1,
    low_eqbound  = -0.20,                   # Cohen's d threshold for a "small" effect
    high_eqbound = 0.20,
    eqbound_type = "SMD",                   # Standardized Mean Difference
    hypothesis   = "EQU"
)
print("=== Standardized TOST: Non-Recurring vs. Recurring ===")
print(tost_recurrence_group_nrec)

tost_recurrence_group_hc <- tsum_TOST(
    m1           = scar_recurring_contrasts_df$estimate[2],
    sd1          = scar_recurring_contrasts_df$SE[2] * sqrt(scar_recurring_contrasts_df$df[2] + 1),
    n1           = scar_recurring_contrasts_df$df[2] + 1,
    low_eqbound  = -0.20,                   # Cohen's d threshold for a "small" effect
    high_eqbound = 0.20,
    eqbound_type = "SMD",                   # Standardized Mean Difference
    hypothesis   = "EQU"
)
print("=== Standardized TOST: Non-Recurring vs. Healthy ===")
print(tost_recurrence_group_hc)
```

```{r}
# Recurrent episodes with interaction
scar_model_recurrent_interaction <- lmer(
    BAG ~ recurrence * assessment_exact + poly(chronological_age, 2) + sex + scale(tiv) + (1 | subject_id) + (1 | scanner),
    data = mnc_macs_longitudinal %>% filter(!is.na(recurrence), group %in% c("CON", "MDD"))
)
scar_model_recurrent_interaction_summary <- summary(scar_model_recurrent_interaction)
print(scar_model_recurrent_interaction_summary)

# Extract parameters from your interaction model
interaction_coef <- coef(scar_model_recurrent_interaction_summary)["recurrenceRecurring:assessment_exact", ]
t_interaction_rec <- interaction_coef["t value"]
df_interaction_rec <- interaction_coef["df"]

# Convert to directional partial correlation
r_interaction_rec <- t_to_r(t = t_interaction_rec, df_error = df_interaction_rec)

# Run standardized TOST (boundary: r = 0.10)
tost_interaction_rec <- corsum_test(
    r           = r_interaction_rec$r,
    n           = df_interaction_rec + 1,
    alternative = "equivalence",
    null        = 0.10,
    method      = "pearson"
)
print("=== Standardized TOST: Recurrence x Time Interaction ===")
print(tost_interaction_rec)
```

```{r}
tidy(scar_model_duration_interaction,  effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE)   # duration:time row
tidy(scar_model_recurrent_interaction, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE)   # recurrence:time row
```

```{r}
# --- PANEL A: DURATION (Continuous) ---
duration_plot_df <- mnc_macs_longitudinal %>%
  filter(group %in% c("MDD", "CON")) %>%
  mutate(
    bag_res = residuals(lm(as.formula(paste("BAG ~", "poly(chronological_age, 2) + sex + scanner")), data = ., na.action = na.exclude)),
    bag_res_lmer = residuals(scar_model_duration),
    duration_res = residuals(lm(as.formula(paste("duration_episodes_depr ~", "poly(chronological_age, 2) + sex + scanner")), data = ., na.action = na.exclude)),
    duration_res_lmer = residuals(lmer(
        duration_episodes_depr ~ poly(chronological_age, 2) + sex + scale(tiv) + 
        (1 | subject_id) + (1 | scanner),
        data = mnc_macs_longitudinal %>% filter(group %in% c("CON", "MDD"))
    ))
  )

p_scar_a <- ggplot(duration_plot_df, aes(x = duration_res_lmer, y = bag_res_lmer, color = group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1, color = "grey50") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", fill = NA, alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "", x = "Cumulative Episode Duration Residuals", y = "BAG Residuals") +
  theme_classic()

# --- PANEL B: RECURRENCE (Categorical) ---
recurrence_plot_df <- mnc_macs_longitudinal %>%
  filter(group %in% c("MDD", "CON"), !is.na(recurrence)) %>%
  mutate(
    bag_res = residuals(lm(as.formula(paste("BAG ~", "poly(chronological_age, 2) + sex + scanner")), data = ., na.action = na.exclude)),
    bag_res_lmer = residuals(scar_model_recurrent)
  )

p_scar_b <- ggplot(recurrence_plot_df, aes(x = recurrence, y = bag_res_lmer, color = recurrence)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
    # geom_violin(alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "black", "black")) +
    geom_jitter(alpha = 0.1, width = 0.15, color = "grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "black", "black"))+
    labs(title = "", x = "Depression Recurrence", y = "BAG Residuals") +
    theme_classic() + theme(legend.position = "none")

scar_plot <- p_scar_a + p_scar_b + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") + 
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = 'A', 
    tag_prefix = '(', 
    tag_suffix = ')'
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14), # Styles your (A) and (B)
    plot.tag.position = c(0, 1)                        # Forces tags to very top-left
  )
print(scar_plot)
ggsave("Analysis_3_Scar.png", scar_plot, width = 6, height = 4)
```
